title: A Asset for the Border
author: Rosalind Underhill
blurb: Ivo Okonkwo, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
